tvShow.name: Quem Ama Cuida
tvShow.overview: A hardworking physical therapist, Adriana is facing multiple challenges at once. After being fired from the clinic where she works, her house is hit by a flood that ends up killing her husband, Carlos. Now homeless and struggling to support her family, Adriana starts working for the Brandãos, a traditional wealthy family from São Paulo, as the caregiver for Artur, the grumpy patriarch. The millionaire jeweler, known for driving away every employee, gradually forms a genuine bond with Adriana, who must also deal with the distrust of the rest of the family.

episodes.name: Chapter 1
episodes.overview: Adriana expresses concern about the rain and asks Carlos for help. Pedro questions Ademir's ethics and refuses his father's invitation to work together. Adriana is fired from the clinic. Cleber suspects Pedro's feelings for Bruna. Pilar informs Ulisses that the lawyer assured her Arthur will be made aware of the guardianship request. Adriana risks everything to help her family.

episodes.name: Chapter 2
episodes.overview: Adriana begs the boatman to rescue her husband. Rafael and Ingrid worry when they learn that their mother has filed for legal incapacitation for their uncle. Seeing Pedro's happiness at the news of the pregnancy, Bruna goes along with her mother's lie. Pedro volunteers to help the homeless and meets Elisa and her family. Adriana learns of Carlos's death, and her family comforts her.

episodes.name: Chapter 3
episodes.overview: Arthur has a conflict with Adriana. Pedro promises to explain to Bruna who owns the bracelet he found. Brigitte watches the images from the microcamera she installed in Pituxo's house. Adriana goes to the job interview with Arthur, and they are both surprised to recognize each other. Arthur hires Adriana as a physiotherapist after they argue. Arthur praises Adriana's work.

episodes.name: Chapter 4
episodes.overview: Arthur praises Adriana's work, but ends up firing her after a misunderstanding. Arthur learns of Adriana's situation and goes to the shelter to look for the physiotherapist. Otoniel treats Arthur with hostility, but Elisa asks if he wants to wait for Adriana to arrive. Cleber notices that Pedro can't get Adriana out of his head. Arthur offers Adriana her job back.

episodes.name: Chapter 5
episodes.overview: Adriana gets emotional when Pedro returns the bracelet she had lost. Adriana is surprised by Pilar, who shows up at the house Arthur lent to the young woman's family and questions what they are doing there. Pilar is hostile towards Adriana and accuses her and her family of having invaded the house where she was raised. Arthur argues with the family.

episodes.name: Chapter 6
episodes.overview: Carmita fakes a fainting spell so Bruna misses her appointment with the obstetrician. A police officer informs Otoniel that he has received a report of home invasion. Ademir informs Arthur that the client's report attests to his mental sanity, but also informs him that the hearing has already been scheduled. Adriana discovers that Otoniel and Elisa have gone to the police station. The police chief informs Otoniel and Elisa that they will be detained.

episodes.name: Chapter 7
episodes.overview: Ademir fears Arthur's confused behavior in front of the Judge. Diná threatens to fire Adriana. Tilde drinks Arthur's orange juice, unaware that Pilar put a tranquilizer in it. The Judge accepts Ademir's request to postpone the hearing. Otoniel tells Elisa about the woman who appeared at the flower stall. Adriana realizes that Pilar sabotaged Arthur's juice. Arthur fires Ingrid in order to get back at Pilar.

episodes.name: Chapter 8
episodes.overview: Pedro seeks out Ademir and tells him about Bruna's pregnancy. Ademir is threatened. Pedro's car is intentionally cut off by another car, causing it to overturn. Arthur proposes to Adriana and makes it clear that he wants her to be the sole inheritor of his fortune. Pedro reacts when the doctor informs him that Bruna was never pregnant. Adriana tells Elisa about Arthur's marriage proposal.

episodes.name: Chapter 9
episodes.overview: Pedro breaks up with Bruna. Adriana tells Elisa about Arthur's marriage proposal. Bruna blames Carmita for the end of her relationship with Pedro. Adriana tells Arthur that she cannot accept the marriage proposal and considers interrupting her physiotherapy treatment. Otoniel breaks into Arthur's house and threatens the jeweler's life in front of Adriana.

episodes.name: Chapter 10
episodes.overview: Arthur is unable to explain his true intentions to Otoniel. Rosa tells Arthur that the boss couldn't have chosen a better person than Adriana to teach the brothers a lesson. Pilar celebrates Otoniel's reaction to Arthur's marriage proposal. Elisa seeks out Arthur to find out the jeweler's true intentions with her daughter, and faints during the conversation.

episodes.name: Chapter 11
episodes.overview: Pedro accepts the case from Ademir's office, despite his suspicions. Bruna asks Tiago for a job. Arthur gathers the employees to announce his upcoming marriage to Adriana. Diná is distressed by the news of Arthur's wedding. Adriana tells Elisa she needs her mother's support. Pedro confesses to Cléber that he's attracted to Adriana. Ulisses returns the car Fábia bought for Felipe. Otoniel is furious to learn that Adriana has agreed to marry Arthur. Elisa tries to reassure Adriana. Arthur's family reacts when he announces his marriage to Adriana.

episodes.name: Chapter 12
episodes.overview: Arthur is moved by Adriana's decision. Pedro accepts the case from Ademir's office, despite his suspicions. Bruna asks Tiago for a job. Arthur gathers the employees to announce his engagement to Adriana. Diná is distressed by the news of Arthur's wedding. Adriana tells Elisa she needs her mother's support. Pedro confesses to Cléber that he is attracted to Adriana. Ulisses returns the car Fábia bought for Felipe. Otoniel is furious to learn that Adriana has agreed to marry Arthur. Elisa tries to reassure Adriana. Arthur's family reacts when he announces his marriage to Adriana.

episodes.name: Chapter 13
episodes.overview: Tiago mentions that the only way for him to rise in the company is with Arthur's death. Ulisses surprises his family with his decisions regarding the money he received from Arthur. Otoniel decides to leave home, much to his family's sadness. Arthur is cleared of Pilar's accusations about his autonomy during the hearing. Carmita seeks out Arthur with the intention of making him give up on his marriage.

episodes.name: Chapter 14
episodes.overview: Adriana argues with Diná, who swears revenge against the young woman. Pilar and Ulisses show that they have changed their minds about not going to their brother's wedding. Pedro is stunned to see that Arthur's bride is Adriana, and reveals that he loves the physiotherapist. During the wedding ceremony, the power goes out in Arthur's building. Adriana is distraught when she finds Arthur lying on the sidewalk.

episodes.name: Chapter 15
episodes.overview: Pilar accuses Adriana of pushing Arthur. Pedro supports Adriana. Adriana tells Elisa that Pilar won't rest until she puts her in jail for Arthur's death. Ulisses lies to Fábia. Pilar gathers Ulisses, Silvana, and Diná to align their statements to the police, blaming Adriana for Arthur's death.

episodes.name: Chapter 16
episodes.overview: The investigator informs the police chief that the preliminary forensic report confirms that Arthur was pushed. Pedro tells Cléber that, after the testimonies, Adriana is the prime suspect in Arthur's death. Pilar asks Ademir to be the Brandão family's lawyer against Adriana. Pilar demands that Ademir use his methods to convict Adriana. Adriana receives a new summons from the police to testify.

episodes.name: Chapter 17
episodes.overview: Tiago lets slip to Silvana that he suspects someone from the Brandão family may have killed Arthur. Fábia discovers that Ulisses lied about his whereabouts on the night of his brother's death. Pedro informs Adriana that he will be her defense lawyer. Pedro makes it clear to Adriana that he is willing to confront his father to defend her. Fábia tells Dora that Ulisses is hiding something.

episodes.name: Chapter 18
episodes.overview: Bruna seeks Ademir's help to get closer to Pedro, and in return he asks the young woman to convince his son to drop the lawsuit against Adriana. Ademir seeks out Pedro. Otoniel arrives at Arthur's apartment saying he agrees to move back in with the family.

episodes.name: Chapter 19
episodes.overview: Ademir tries to convince Pedro to drop the lawsuit against Adriana. Adriana convinces Otoniel to let her take Arthur's room. Diná tells Pilar that Adriana went to the jewelry store. Tom apologizes to Elenice. Pilar goes to the jewelry store and accuses Adriana of killing Arthur. Ulisses feels guilty. Due to Fábia's insistence, Ulisses lies to his wife about his whereabouts.

episodes.name: Chapter 20
episodes.overview: Adriana feels uncomfortable in front of the police chief. Elisa shares her concern with Tilde. Otoniel visits Arthur's grave. Rosa warns Elenice about Tom. While talking to Adriana and Mau Mau about the deposition, Elisa feels unwell and faints. Pedro catches Brigitte and Cleber together in the office and is incredulous. Pilar breaks into Adriana's apartment, which used to belong to Arthur, and starts collecting belongings.

episodes.name: Chapter 21
episodes.overview: Carmita encourages Bruna to go out with Tiago. Adriana and Otoniel go to the farm to assist Elisa, who has fallen ill. Pilar goes to the police station and says that Adriana has fled. Pilar is pleased when the police chief decides to issue an arrest warrant for Adriana. Otoniel shares with Adriana his concern about the lack of a medical diagnosis for Elisa. Adriana is arrested.

episodes.name: Chapter 22
episodes.overview: Otoniel informs Pedro that Adriana has been arrested. Pedro promises to get Adriana out of jail. Pedro confronts Pilar. Edvaldo accuses Diná of ​​pushing Arthur off the balcony out of jealousy. Adriana confronts Pilar. Adriana and Pilar argue. Pedro suggests that Cléber step away from Adriana's case. Dora fears that Adriana's case will drive a wedge between Ademir and Pedro. Adriana and Otoniel worry about Elisa's health.

episodes.name: Chapter 23
episodes.overview: Edvaldo accuses Diná of ​​causing Adriana's arrest. Adriana is heartbroken to hear the judge's decision to uphold her pre-trial detention. Pedro promises Adriana that he will not give up on her. Pilar feels victorious.

episodes.name: Chapter 24
episodes.overview: In her cell, Adriana tries to stay strong and prays for justice. Dora reminisces about her family's past affections connected to the Dance School and considers returning to work. Cléber analyzes the testimonies and discovers that Diná harbored a passion for Arthur. Tilde describes, in a flashback during her testimony, Diná's jealousy and hostility towards Adriana since her arrival. In the visiting room, Pedro tries to cheer Adriana up.

episodes.name: Chapter 25
episodes.overview: Cléber reminds Pedro that he can defend Adriana as a prosecution witness, and assures him that he is prepared to act in the case. Adriana is surprised when Tom is announced as a prosecution witness in her trial. Pedro defends Adriana in his testimony, revealing his feelings for her.

episodes.name: Chapter 26
episodes.overview: Tom receives money from Ademir for following the lawyer's instructions during his testimony. Silvana seeks out Ademir to tell him she's afraid of what Pilar and Ulisses might plot against Tiago. Bruna gives in to Tiago's request to give them both a chance. Cléber makes it clear to Brigitte that he wants nothing to do with her. Adriana tells Pedro that she would be the happiest woman in the world if she could reciprocate his love.

episodes.name: Chapter 27
episodes.overview: Diná visits Arthur's grave and asks for forgiveness. Under pressure from Ademir, Edvaldo reveals that Adriana and Arthur slept in separate rooms. Adriana testifies firmly and speaks of the possibility that another person committed the crime, including Ademir. Adriana is sentenced to twelve years in prison in a closed regime. Adriana asks him not to give up on her. The two look at each other and give in to a passionate kiss.

episodes.name: Chapter 28
episodes.overview: Dora tells Ademir that her husband helped condemn an ​​innocent woman. Lyris advises Adriana to stay away from Nancy. Adriana says that she also loves Pedro and that this budding love gives her hope. Pedro definitively cuts off his relationship with Ademir. Pilar surprises Otoniel and his family, kicking them all out of Arthur's house.

episodes.name: Chapter 29
episodes.overview: Otoniel decides to leave Arthur's house with his family. Maurício prevents Elisa from confronting Pilar, fearing for her mother's health. Pedro confesses to Bruna that he loves Adriana. Otoniel retrieves Adriana's bracelet from Heitor's room. Rosa offers her house to Elisa and her family.

episodes.name: Chapter 30
episodes.overview: Pilar sets up an attack on the bank where Otoniel works. Silvana tells Ulisses that Pilar is moving to Arthur's house. Pedro probes Tom about how much he received from Ademir to testify against Adriana. Pilar's henchman visits Adriana, and threatens Pedro's life if the therapist doesn't stay away from the lawyer. To save Pedro, Adriana breaks up with the lawyer, saying she doesn't love him.

episodes.name: Chapter 31
episodes.overview: Pilar moves into Arthur's house. Ademir instructs Tom to deny having been bribed by him. Ulisses and Silvana object to Pilar occupying Arthur's property. Elenice seeks out Pedro to discuss her suspicions regarding Tom. Bruna tells Gilda she hopes to get back together with Pedro.

episodes.name: Chapter 32
episodes.overview: Zeni threatens Adriana. Elenice manages to send Tom’s bank statement to Pedro, showing proof of the deposit Ademir made to her husband. Pilar considers questioning Tiago’s paternity through Ademir. Brigitte lets the air out of Cléber’s car tires. Ademir tells Silvana that Pilar and Ulisses are questioning Tiago’s paternity.

episodes.name: Chapter 33
episodes.overview: André decides to work at Ademir's office to observe his moves and help Pedro. Pedro and Cléber decide to attach the screenshot of Tom's bank statement to the case files. Ingrid speaks with Brigitte about the restraining order and, despite scolding her sister, also takes her in. Lyris warns that Nancy is coming out of isolation and tries to scare Adriana.

episodes.name: Chapter 34
episodes.overview: Nancy leaves solitary confinement. Zeni and Marlene discuss Nancy's return and the fact that she is sharing a cell with Adriana. Rosa praises Elenice's courage in obtaining proof of the bribe, but her daughter continues to insist that Tom can change. Dora proposes a contest to promote the dance school and attract new students. A moved Adriana reads the statements from all the witnesses.

episodes.name: Chapter 35
episodes.overview: Adriana thanks Nancy for defending her. Nancy tells Adriana the reason she was arrested. André tells his uncle that he returned to Brazil to work with him. Pedro tells Elisa that Ademir bribed Tom. Otoniel talks to Francesca about Adriana's situation. Ademir receives a subpoena to explain the deposits made to Tom's account.

episodes.name: Chapter 36
episodes.overview: Nívea assigns Zeni a mission to act against Adriana. Nancy warns Adriana to be careful around Zeni. Silvana makes it clear to Ademir that no one will touch her son's inheritance. Ulisses tells Pilar that his company needs money. Otoniel confronts Tom after learning that he accepted a bribe from Ademir to testify against his granddaughter. Tom forbids Elenice from visiting Adriana.

episodes.name: Chapter 37
episodes.overview: Tom forbids Elenice from visiting Adriana. Pedro denies Bruna a second chance, stating that he loves Adriana. Carolina notices Ulysses’ tension. Francesca and Otoniel almost kiss. Ulysses borrows money from a loan shark. Zeni attacks Adriana and steals her bracelet.

episodes.name: Chapter 38
episodes.overview: Nancy and Lyris bet that it was Zeni who assaulted Adriana. André informs Pedro that Adriana was attacked in prison. Brigitte tells Edvaldo that she, too, does not believe Adriana is to blame for Arthur's death. Pilar gets annoyed with Rosa because the employee is unwilling to provide information about Adriana's family. Pilar asks Ademir to appoint her as the executor of Arthur's estate.

episodes.name: Chapter 39
episodes.overview: Maurício tells Elenice that he is never invited to events with his school friends. Pedro is hostile toward Ingrid. Carolina and André kiss. Adriana tells Nancy and Lyris that it was Zeni who attacked her. Ademir claims he hired Tom's services to clear himself of the bribery accusation. Jandira decides to transfer Zeni from the prison.

episodes.name: Chapter 40
episodes.overview: Pedro informs Ademir that he will do everything in his power to ensure Arthur's inheritance does not go to the jeweler's family or to his father. Adriana is surprised by the applause she receives from the other inmates for having managed to get Zeni transferred out of the prison. Adriana tells Nancy she is determined to go after everyone responsible for having her convicted of a crime she did not commit.

episodes.name: Chapter 41
episodes.overview: Dora tries to hide her reaction upon seeing Carolina kissing André. Pedro feels powerless because he cannot secure Adriana's freedom. Ulisses is kidnapped by the loan shark's henchmen. Ulisses tells Carolina that he was robbed and attacked by thugs. Pilar admits to Ademir that she paid someone to attack Adriana, but denies having pushed Arthur.

episodes.name: Chapter 42
episodes.overview: Lyris tells Adriana that she may be released from prison soon. André and Dora kiss during rehearsal. Otoniel tells Adriana that Elisa has been diagnosed with fibromyalgia. Carolina and André win the dance competition. There is a time jump. Bruna and Pedro return from their trip, married. Adriana obtains her parole and vows to seek justice.

episodes.name: Chapter 43
episodes.overview: Rafael celebrates his partnership with César at the clinic. André advises Ademir to seek out Pedro. Carmita is shocked to learn from Bruna that her daughter and Pedro will be living with her. Pilar demands that Fernando work in exchange for housing, and he offers to join Rafael's clinic team. Tiago is shaken to learn of Bruna's marriage.

episodes.name: Chapter 44
episodes.overview: Pilar confronts Adriana. Adriana reveals to Maurício the reason she distanced herself from Pedro. Bruna argues with Carmita. Brigitte complains about Pilar to Tilde. Bia makes it clear to César that she dislikes Pilar. Fábia tells Dora that Ulisses has changed a lot since receiving Arthur's inheritance. Dora recognizes Otoniel. Ulisses loses money gambling. Bruna asks Tiago for a job at the jewelry store.

episodes.name: Chapter 45
episodes.overview: Pedro seeks out Ademir to say that he still hopes his father will become a better person. Pilar and her driver are held up and forced out of the car. Adriana and Pedro meet while volunteering at the shelter. Pedro tells Adriana that he hasn't given up on finding out who killed Arthur. Ulisses informs Pilar that her driver died following the robbery.

episodes.name: Chapter 46
episodes.overview: Pedro leaves his cell phone at home, and Bruna takes the device to her husband at the shelter. Ulisses wins money gambling, and Lyris, who works as a waitress at the casino, advises him to stop. Adriana is shaken to discover that Pedro has married Bruna. Tom is hostile toward Adriana and kicks her out of his house. Cléber reminds Adriana of the obligations of her parole.

episodes.name: Chapter 47
episodes.overview: Ulisses gets jealous when he sees Patrick with Fábia. Lyris thanks Nicolau for not abandoning her. Otoniel finds a book in Maurício’s backpack and questions his grandson. Adriana is dismayed when a clinic receptionist informs her that her interview has been cancelled because she is an ex-convict. Adriana defends Maurício against Otoniel’s behavior. Pilar threatens Adriana’s family.

episodes.name: Chapter 48
episodes.overview: Pedro tries to explain himself to Adriana and lets slip that he is unhappy. Camilo reacts coldly upon meeting Lyris, and Nancy remarks that the young man never forgave her for his father's death. Adriana decides to attend Ademir's lecture. Pedro is left confused when Cléber asks if he would have the courage to end his marriage to be with Adriana. Otoniel refuses to speak with Brigitte.

episodes.name: Chapter 49
episodes.overview: Fábia explains to Dora why she left the dance class. Pedro pumps André for information about Dora. Otoniel informs Rosa that the family will have to leave their friend's house. Ulisses asks Carolina and Felipe for help reconciling with Fábia. Adriana accuses Ademir of having bribed witnesses to secure her conviction. Pedro calls Bruna by Adriana's name.

episodes.name: Chapter 50
episodes.overview: Rosa threatens Pilar to protect Adriana's family. Lyris gives Ulisses advice regarding Fábia. Laurentino tells Nancy about his past romance with Silvana. Brigitte lands a job at Nicolau's café. Adriana gets a job at a beauty salon. Fábia and Ulisses make up. Bruna and Carmita react when Pedro states that he will not attend his father's birthday party.

episodes.name: Chapter 51
episodes.overview: Carmita overhears the argument between Pedro and Bruna. Adriana tells Nancy she hasn't given up on her revenge. Bruna and Carmita decide to go to Ademir's party without Pedro. Carmita tells Ademir that Pedro will investigate Arthur's murder on his own. Bruna demands that Adriana stay away from Pedro. Mau Mau tells Pedro that Bruna went to his house to provoke Adriana. Adriana watches Lyris talking to Ulisses.

episodes.name: Chapter 52
episodes.overview: Pilar causes a scene and makes accusations against Adriana. Pilar is charmed by Iuri. Adriana asks Mau Mau for help in finding something that could damage Ademir. André thinks about Dora. Rosa worries about Elenice. Adriana tells Lyris that Ulisses is Arthur's brother and asks her friend to find out things that could help with her revenge.

episodes.name: Chapter 53
episodes.overview: Adriana tells Lyris that Ulisses is Arthur's brother and asks her friend to find out things that could help her in her revenge. Camilo refuses Nancy's help. Brigitte is charmed by César. Adriana asks Nancy and Lyris if she can count on her friends to get revenge on the people who put her in jail. Ademir convinces Pilar not to file a criminal complaint against Adriana.

episodes.name: Chapter 54
episodes.overview: Elisa can't dissuade Adriana from her revenge. Andréa tells Joel she can't tell Rafael she doesn't have money, so she won't be rejected. Pilar tells Ingrid she wants to orchestrate her daughter's appointment as president of the jewelry company. Bruna reprimands Carmita. Silvana tells Dora how she discovered Fábia was secretly visiting Arthur. Ulisses invites Lyris out.

episodes.name: Chapter 55
episodes.overview: Adriana discovers that Ademir is having a relationship with Suely. Bruna refuses to go to the hospital, and Pedro reminds his wife of the doctor's recommendations. Ademir fires Suely, and Adriana takes the opportunity to offer the secretary help. Edson convinces Carmita to take out a bank loan for him. Ingrid tells Pilar that she would like to take over the presidency of the jewelry company.

episodes.name: Chapter 56
episodes.overview: Silvana goes to Pedro’s office to represent Tiago. Gilda tells Tiago about the family's plan to remove him from his position. Suely reveals information about Ademir during a meeting with Adriana. Silvana coordinates with Pedro and Cléber on how to represent Tiago. Pilar watches Iuri. Suely goes to Pedro to report Ademir and is surprised to learn of the lawyer's family connection to her former boss.

episodes.name: Chapter 57
episodes.overview: Suely learns Adriana's true identity from Mirtes; Adriana had posed as Ivone to gain the secretary's trust. Dora refuses to believe André when he claims Ademir is cheating on her. Bruna refuses to tell Carmita about her illness, and Pedro disagrees with this decision. Suely pressures Adriana to explain why she concealed her real name and recommended Pedro as the lawyer.

episodes.name: Chapter 58
episodes.overview: Adriana tells Suely how Ademir treated her unfairly. Tiago threatens Ulisses, Pilar, and Ingrid. Otoniel invites Elza to dinner. Fábia tells Carmita that her friend has fallen victim to a scam and suggests asking the police for help. Ademir offers to help Ingrid manage the jewelry store. Brigitte sends flowers to César. Suely informs Pedro that she wants him to represent her in filing a complaint against Ademir.

episodes.name: Chapter 59
episodes.overview: Adriana is thrilled to learn that Ademir will be served with a formal notice. Edvaldo is happy to hear that Tilde’s fiancé has broken up with the employee. Bia complains to Bruna about the anonymous flowers sent to César. Carmita manages to identify Edson’s license plate number. Elisa fears that Ademir might harm Adriana. Carmita and Fábia discover that Edson left the hotel without paying the bill.

episodes.name: Chapter 60
episodes.overview: Tiago falls asleep on the sofa at Bruna and Pedro's house. Carmita is distraught upon realizing she has been scammed by Edson. Ademir receives a threatening anonymous email, and Dora worries. Suely tells Adriana that she sent an anonymous email to Ademir, warning him that his life is about to become a living hell. Silvana picks up Tiago from Bruna's house. Otoniel laments that his date with Elza didn't work out.

episodes.name: Chapter 61
episodes.overview: Francesca's identity is revealed. Otoniel thinks about Francesca. Pedro tells Adriana about the lawsuit against Ademir, unaware that the physical therapist orchestrated the whole thing with Suely. Rafael praises Ingrid for the party celebrating the presidency.

episodes.name: Chapter 62
episodes.overview: Pilar notices her ring has been stolen and blames the staff. Bruna tells Tiago that he must view her only as a friend. Ademir receives a summons to testify. Carmita has the ring she stole from Pilar appraised. Pilar spots Elisa on the street and orders Iuri to force her into the car.

episodes.name: Chapter 63
episodes.overview: Brigitte tells Adriana she believes in her innocence. Carmita discovers that the ring from Joalheria Brandão is a fake. Ingrid and Tiago argue. Lyris suggests that Adriana use Brigitte in her plans for revenge. Ademir discovers that Pedro is representing Suely. Elisa visits Arthur's grave and asks for help in keeping Pilar away from her family. Carmita finds out that Pilar is going to call the police.

episodes.name: Chapter 64
episodes.overview: Carmita returns the ring to Pilar and warns her that the jewel is fake. Otoniel finds Francesca. Adriana watches with satisfaction as Ademir is surrounded by the press as he enters the police station to testify. Pilar accuses Carmita of making up the story that her ring is fake. Adriana and Mau Mau celebrate the repercussions of the accusation against Ademir, and Patrick tries to reassure Dora.

episodes.name: Chapter 65
episodes.overview: Ingrid confesses to Pilar that she would swap the prototype for the real ring once her mother finished paying for the purchase. Bruna discovers that Pedro is the lawyer for the woman who filed the complaint against Ademir. Otoniel tells Adriana that Pilar kidnapped Elisa and threatened her daughter. Cléber informs Pedro that two more women want to file complaints against Ademir. Adriana goes to Pilar's house.

episodes.name: Chapter 66
episodes.overview: Adriana fears jeopardizing her parole when Pilar threatens to report her for trespassing. Rafael demands that Brigitte stay away from César. Dora kicks Ademir out of the house. Carolina is taken aback when André ends their relationship, confessing that he loves another woman. Bruna and Pedro argue over Carmita. Dora feels uncomfortable when Carolina reveals that André has ended the relationship.

episodes.name: Chapter 67
episodes.overview: Pedro offers to help Adriana get a job. André offers his support to Dora. Ademir discovers that Pedro is the lawyer for the new women who denounced him. Bruna watches Pedro and Adriana talking, without being seen. André confesses to Pedro that he is in love with Dora. Dora tells Ademir that the marriage is over.

episodes.name: Chapter 68
episodes.overview: Pedro feels revulsion toward his father. Adriana discovers that Bruna believes she and Pedro are lovers. Lyris asks Ulisses for help leaving the casino. Nancy asks Adriana to examine Joel. Lyris tells Ulisses she is on parole. Elisa accepts Enéas's invitation. Ingrid fires Ulisses.

episodes.name: Chapter 69
episodes.overview: Rafael asks Brigitte to stop pursuing César. Pedro realizes that Bruna has taken a sleeping pill. Joel shows interest in Adriana. Fernando praises Mau Mau. Bia is annoyed when Brigitte and Rafael sit at the table with her and César, interrupting the couple's romantic dinner. Elenice blames Rosa for her falling-out with Adriana.

episodes.name: Chapter 70
episodes.overview: Otoniel masks the shock he felt upon seeing Francesca's portrait and tells Joel he had a sudden drop in blood pressure. Pedro gets annoyed with Carmita. Fábia confronts Pilar and criticizes her husband's submissive attitude toward his sister-in-law. Ulisses promises Pilar he will stand by Ingrid. Pilar tries to convince Ingrid that her daughter needs Ulisses at the jewelry store.

episodes.name: Chapter 71
episodes.overview: Pedro reacts badly to Pilar's visit. Ademir is surprised to see Adriana and Suely together. Ademir surprises Suely by asking her what the former secretary was doing with Adriana. Suely warns Ademir not to come closer to her. Nancy feels Camilo's indifference. Tiago tells Ingrid that she is not competent to preside over the jewelry store. Adriana sees Pedro and Bruna at the restaurant.

episodes.name: Chapter 72
episodes.overview: Bruna humiliates Adriana for working as a waitress. Ademir threatens to send Adriana back to jail. Suely tells Dora about being harassed by Ademir. Joel and Otoniel talk about Francesca. Cléber is surprised when Pedro informs him that he has resumed investigating the Arthur Brandão case. Carmita tells Pilar that Adriana is working at a restaurant.

episodes.name: Chapter 73
episodes.overview: Carmita tells Pilar that Adriana is working at a restaurant. Pedro celebrates Bruna's improved health. Dora runs into Ademir at her dance studio. Bruna tries to sabotage her treatment to keep Pedro by her side. André discovers that the expert who signed Arthur's report was involved in fraud and was found dead. Adriana and Iuri meet up.

episodes.name: Chapter 74
episodes.overview: Edvaldo catches Iuri rummaging through the office that used to belong to Arthur. Diná feels humiliated by Pilar. Nancy suggests that Adriana open her heart to Joel, but she insists she still loves Pedro. Adriana mentions to Otoniel that Arthur's cherished ring has gone missing. Pedro tells Adriana about Bruna's illness and states his intention to separate from his wife. Pedro and Adriana kiss.

episodes.name: Chapter 75
episodes.overview: Elisa interrupts the atmosphere between Pedro and Adriana. Edvaldo records Pilar watching Iuri parading around in bathing suits. Francesca appears to Otoniel and claims that Arthur's ring is at her ex-boss's house. Brigitte accuses Bia of not taking proper care of her daughter. Ademir reflects on Carmita's idea of ​​staying at his house to spend time with Pedro.

episodes.name: Chapter 76
episodes.overview: Dora makes it clear to Ademir that her marriage is over. Silvana agrees to celebrate her birthday with her family, at Tiago's insistence. Pedro is perplexed to learn that Ademir will be staying at Carmita's house. Bruna despairs when Pedro insinuates that he wants to separate. Pedro invites Adriana to dinner. Adriana declares her love for Pedro, and the two spend the night together.

episodes.name: Chapter 77
episodes.overview: Adriana confesses to Pedro that she still fears the threat. Rosa tells Pilar that her employer should be kinder to Brigitte and threatens to reveal everything she knows about the young woman's father. Bruna reacts when Pedro decides to put an end to their relationship. Elisa explains to Adriana and Mau Mau that Otoniel sees spirits. Adriana mentions to Nancy that she needs to find out what problems Ulisses is facing.

episodes.name: Chapter 78
episodes.overview: Dora feels guilty and asks André to leave. Otoniel tells Adriana and Mau Mau about Francesca. Adriana orders Iuri to look for Arthur's ring. Pilar humiliates Brigitte in front of Bia. Edvaldo catches Iuri in Diná's room with Arthur's ring, and Iuri is forced to reveal to the employee that he is working undercover for Adriana. Adriana finds a clue in Arthur's ring.

episodes.name: Chapter 79
episodes.overview: Pilar kicks Brigitte out of the house. Pedro asks Ademir if he paid the expert in Adriana's case to falsify the report. Adriana discovers that Arthur left valuable jewelry and gold bars in her name in a bank safe-deposit box. Adriana concludes that Arthur had a premonition that something bad might happen to him. Ingrid and Rafael scold their mother for kicking Brigitte out of the house.

episodes.name: Chapter 80
episodes.overview: Iuri is seduced by Ingrid. Diná tells Pilar that Brigitte is staying at Ulisses's house. Fábia makes a slip-up while talking to Carmita—within earshot of Bruna—about the scam her friend fell victim to. Ademir invites Cléber to work with him. Adriana discovers in Pedro's notes that the forensic report on her case may have been tampered with to frame her.

episodes.name: Chapter 81
episodes.overview: Adriana thanks Pedro for not giving up on the two of them. Cléber refuses to work with Ademir. Bruna and Carmita are surprised when Ademir decides to pay off his bank debt. Elisa tells Otoniel to seek advice regarding his spiritual gift. Pedro argues with Cléber. Ademir tells Luan he needs to figure out a way to weaken Pedro. Silvana is surprised to receive flowers from Laurentino.

episodes.name: Chapter 82
episodes.overview: Adriana authorizes Iuri to sell the jewelry to the buyer he found. Pilar and Brigitte face off at Silvana's birthday party. Pilar treats Brigitte rudely in front of the entire family. Adriana mentions her concerns about the jewelry sale to Mau Mau. Nicolau retorts to Pilar's insults. Ingrid leaves Silvana's party, goes to the jewelry store with Iuri, and the two end up together.

episodes.name: Chapter 83
episodes.overview: Joel doesn't believe the story Otoniel tells him about how he met Francesca, but he acknowledges Otoniel's affection. Elisa asks Enéas not to mention to Otoniel that the two of them are seeing each other. César is worried about Brigitte. Adriana and Mau Mau witness César being mugged. Pedro and Ademir argue in front of Bruna and Carmita. Silvana suggests to Tiago that they both try to get closer to Ulisses.

episodes.name: Chapter 84
episodes.overview: Adriana tells Mau Mau she is afraid Pedro will judge her because of the revenge plan. Otoniel mentions to Elisa that Joel didn't believe his story about Francesca. Carmita thanks Ademir for paying off her bank debt. Adriana takes note when Pedro mentions that André and Dora love each other.

episodes.name: Chapter 85
episodes.overview: Adriana lies to Pedro and goes with Iuri to meet the buyer of the jewelry. Pedro decides to wait for Adriana at her home to find out the reason for her lie. Adriana sells the jewelry to a sheikh. She tells Pedro and her family about the inheritance she received from Arthur and gains her boyfriend's support when she reveals her plan for revenge.

episodes.name: Chapter 86
episodes.overview: André goes to Bruna's house and hands over the draft divorce agreement. Bruna is distressed to realize that the separation is truly moving forward. Carmita is furious when she discovers that Bruna married under a complete separation of assets regime. Carmita tells Tiago that Bruna is going to separate from Pedro. Ulisses loses money gambling. Adriana predicts that Bruna might use her illness to avoid the separation.

episodes.name: Chapter 87
episodes.overview: Dora and André kiss. Pedro is surprised by Pilar's visit. Adriana looks for Bruna. Bruna feels the blow when Adriana accuses her of trying to destroy Pedro's love for her. Pedro denies Pilar that he is with Adriana. Dora and André declare their love. Lyris advises Ulysses to seek help to get rid of his gambling addiction.

episodes.name: Chapter 88
episodes.overview: Adriana and Nancy discover that Ulisses is addicted to gambling and is deep in debt. Mau Mau becomes tense when Dora asks if Felipe and Carolina remembered the young man's relationship with Adriana. André tells Cléber and Pedro that he got the address of the widow of the expert in Adriana's case. Adriana instructs Lyris to advise Ulisses to sell his share of the jewelry store, already thinking about buying it.

seasons.name: Season 1
seasons.overview: After losing her job at a physical therapy clinic, Adriana’s life takes a devastating turn when a flood destroys her home and claims the life of her husband, Carlos. Left with nowhere to go and a family depending on her, she accepts a job working for the powerful Brandão family in São Paulo as the caretaker of Artur, their difficult and ill-tempered patriarch. Despite his reputation for scaring off every caregiver hired before her, Adriana slowly earns Artur’s trust, while facing constant judgment and suspicion from the rest of the family.
